newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras sees $360 mln from 96-97 coffee exports.
newsitem.headline: Honduras sees $360 mln from 96-97 coffee exports.

text.p: Honduras should earn $360 millon from 1996-1997 coffee crop exports because of the rebound in international bean prices, the manager of the Honduran Coffee Institute Fernando Montes said Wednesday.
"If prices continue as they have been we expect to collect more than $360 million from coffee exports," Montes said.
Honduras coffee exports generated some $300 million from the 1995-1996 crop. Coffee is the nation's principal export product.
The 46-kg bags of coffee are exported at about $160.
This season's crop is expected to produce about 250,000 bags less than the previous harvest because of rains in October and November.
Honduran exports from the 1995-1996 coffee crop totalled about 2.4 million 46-kg bags.
